cases.name: Athina Renee Hopson
cases.narrative: Shot in the head. Hopson was reported missing by her mother on March 21. Wright allegedly told investigators he shot and killed her on March 17 before dumping her body in a river. Her body has not been recovered, since Wright allegedly put her in a river.
